objective: Implement deterministic quality-weighted, independence-capped evidence fusion over the canonical P14-A EvidenceBundle without treating the fusion score as calibrated probability or trade authority.
scope: Preserve hard-veto as a non-bypassable BLOCKED state
Exclude expired evidence from fusion while preserving excluded evidence identities
Collapse evidence by independence_group so each group contributes at most one representative
Select representative deterministically by maximum absolute quality-adjusted strength then evidence_id
Compute deterministic integer signed fusion score across independent representatives
Expose supporting/opposing/neutral groups and source-family coverage
Require at least three directional independent groups and at least two source families for FUSED state
out_of_scope: Portfolio risk, position sizing, risk approval or execution
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: open PR none, active task none, active lock none
tests: Three independent directional groups across at least two source families produce FUSED
Evidence sharing one independence_group contributes at most one representative
Representative selection is deterministic and content-based
Expired evidence is excluded and its identity preserved
Hard veto returns BLOCKED without fusion score
Insufficient directional groups or source-family diversity returns INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
Input order does not change result identity
No family-prior or LLM weighting is allowed
P14-B evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P14-B module/policy/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P14-A remains canonical and P14-C remains unstarted.
definition_of_done: Independence cap and expiry/veto behavior enforced
Deterministic evidence and strict CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
